$comment: Runtime config for this landing. This file is served as-is from the public folder and is fetched by the page on every load, so editing it changes the landing WITHOUT a rebuild. Reload the page (or let the dev watcher pick it up) and the landing re-renders.

game.$comment: balance/bets/betIndex: starting balance, bet ladder for the -/+ buttons, initially selected bet. jackpots: values shown in the plates. winAnimation: 'line' or 'border'. Times are in ms. spins: played in order, then the bonus popup opens — type 'smallwin' | 'bigwin' | 'lose'; winLine = winning row (0-2) per reel, null = none; result = 3 icons (1-8, top to bottom) per reel. desktop has 5 reels, mobile (touch devices) 3.

assets.$comment: Values are either a built-in key (a filename under src/assets/img or src/assets/sound, no extension) or a URL. A URL starting with / , ./ , http:// or https:// is used verbatim, so you can drop custom art into the public folder and point at it here. Reel icons (src/assets/img/icon/icon-1..8.png) are not configurable here.

dev.$comment: watch polls this file and re-renders the landing in place when it changes. menu enables the config editor panel — it ships in the production build too, where it saves edits to the browser's localStorage only (use 'Download' to export a config.json to deploy).
